title: The Turnip Shadow Matinee
description: The harvest matinee starts when a carved turnip lights the barn stage. An antlered hare tips his hat to a toad, and the front row applauds.
alt: Two children clap as the shadows of an antlered hare and a ruffed toad fill a glowing barn screen. A carved turnip lantern sits on a stick at left.
pairing: An autumn harvest holiday × a turnip-lit shadow play
